chunks: Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the muhrim taking a bath, so he said:
"Yes, and he may pour water over his head, but he should not scrub it."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.يَغْتَسِلُ: takes a bath; performs ghusl or washing

ai.seo_question: Can a person in ihram take a bath and pour water over the head?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the muhrim during ihram. It permits bathing and pouring water over the head, while forbidding rubbing or scrubbing the head.
